notes: Page is a Parcoursup fiche for a private programme; it gives no duration, teaching-language or non-EU tuition figures, so those facts are omitted. The stated €4,600/€5,800 training fees and €172 registration fees are Parcoursup 'par année' figures not identified as the non-EU differentiated rate, so tuition is left out. The B2 French level and the DAP procedure quote explicitly concern the filing of an application; programmePage points to the fiche formation, which is the programme's own page under the task.
